title: AI Change Management Consultant
description:
Nion is an IT consultancy and Tech Partner with offices in Stockholm, Malmö, Gothenburg, Skopje, Bitola and Sofia, where 200+ IT specialists work together to deliver tailored digital solutions. We help mid-market and large organisations across the Nordics and the UK simplify complex challenges and turn AI ambition into real business value.


What we do spans Data, AI and Adoption. We bring agnostic data and AI platforms, Forward Deployed Engineers embedded inside client teams, AI-first Cloud Teams, and hands-on advisory and adoption — because sustainable change covers platforms, processes and people, not just technology. This unique combination of advisory, adoption and deep technical delivery capability is what lets us create enormous value for our customers. But that value is only realised through active dialogue and experienced change management at management-team level — and that is exactly where this role sits.


We are looking for an experienced AI Change Management Consultant — based in our Stockholm office and working with clients across the Nordics, the UK. We already have many of the pieces: the engineering foundation and the Forward Deployed Engineers who build AI into live operations, the data platforms, infrastructure and tooling, and our education and enablement services. What we need are experienced consultants to lead theorganisational and human side of AI transformation — who takes a medium or large organisation that is still experimenting with AI, with a traditional mindset and traditional structures, and guides it to become a genuinely AI-first organisation across organisation, processes, infrastructure, platforms, tools and, above all, people.

**What the role is about**
==========================


This is a change-management and organisational-advisory role — a management consultant with a genuine focus on organisation, ways of working and people — combined with a deep, current understanding of AI transformation and what it actually takes to move an enterprise from AI experiments to an AI-first operating model.


You work at senior manager and leadership level to set direction, and you work with the client organisations to make change real. Our research and delivery experience is clear on one point: the characteristics that make an organisation ready for AI — fast flow, psychological safety, shared decision-making, agility, and clear, measurable processes — are the same characteristics that have made organisations successful for the past twenty years. Your job is to build that readiness deliberately, but also help organisations to shift mindset, organisation, and process to fully take advantage of the emerging capabilities of AI.


Our vision for AI is human-centric. AI deployed in a robust but safe and governable way, has the potential to free up human attention and creativity towards vision, innovation, judgement, quality and accountability. AI amplifies, which applies to the good and the bad. It also exposes silos, unclear ownership and broken processes. You help organisations navigate that shift with clarity and confidence, not fear. You therefore help establish Nion as a trusted partner on all levels from strategy, through change and adoption, to technology and delivery.

**What you'll do**
------------------


You own the change agenda from ambition to adopted reality, working across five areas:

* AI readiness & maturity assessment — diagnosing where a client really is: process maturity, data foundations, team dynamics, governance, leadership alignment and cultural readiness — and defining a realistic destination.
* Transformation strategy & operating model — designing the target AI-first operating model: how work is organised, where decisions sit, which processes are redesigned, and how the organisation governs architecture, data, quality and accountability.
* Change & adoption leadership — stakeholder management, communication, capability building and behavioural change so that new ways of working are embraced across the organisation and outlast the engagement.
* Governance, sovereignty & compliance — embedding governance, risk and responsible-AI practice — data, digital and AI sovereignty, GDPR and the EU AI Act — as active leadership decisions, built in rather than bolted on.
* Value & orchestration — quantifying business value, prioritising where to start fast, and orchestrating Nion's engineers, data specialists, educators and the client's own teams into one coherent transformation programme.

Throughout, you translate between the boardroom and the delivery team, and you account for business value, AI spend, total cost of ownership, sovereignty, governance and compliance at every step.

**Your profile**
----------------

* Minimum 8 years in management consulting, organisational development or transformation, with a strong track record in change management and ways-of-working change in medium and large organisations
* A genuine, current understanding of AI and its organisational implications — what generative AI, and agentic AI change about how work is designed, governed and performed (you don't need to build the models, but you must understand how teams and organisations work with them)
* Proven ability to run enterprise change: operating-model design, process redesign, stakeholder management, capability building and adoption at scale
* Strong command of a recognised change-management approach (e.g. ADKAR/Prosci, Kotter or equivalent) and comfort adapting it to AI-driven transformation. Also comfortable tailoring your own approach based on the constraints and needs of the client.
* Solid understanding of AI governance, data protection and responsible AI — GDPR and the EU AI Act — and how to make them practical for leadership teams
* Confident and credible with C-level and board stakeholders, and equally comfortable embedded with the teams doing the work
* Able to quantify value and connect transformation to measurable business outcomes — comfortable selling and delivering outcomes rather than headcount
* Fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken
  

This is not a technical delivery or engineering role. We are looking for an advisor and change leader, not a builder of models or automations — that is what our Forward Deployed Engineers do, and you will work hand in hand with them. What sets you apart is that you understand AI transformation deeply enough to lead the organisational change it demands.

### **Frameworks & areas you'll work with**

* Change & org: ADKAR/Prosci, Kotter, operating-model and target-operating-model design, process redesign, team-dynamics and culture assessment
* AI transformation: AI maturity and readiness models, use-case and value assessment, the three levels of AI (generative, assistant, agentic), pilot-to-production thinking
* Governance & compliance: EU AI Act readiness, GDPR, AI governance frameworks, risk assessment, data/digital/AI sovereignty
* Value & delivery: business-case and ROI modelling, KPI and benefits realisation, agile ways of working, portfolio prioritisation
### **Meritorious**

* Experience leading AI or large-scale digital transformation programmes end to end
* Formal change-management certification (Prosci/ADKAR or equivalent)
* Domain experience in telecom, fintech or insurance
* Familiarity with data platforms, cloud and modern software delivery — enough to be credible with technical teams
* Experience with EU AI Act readiness or AI governance assignments
### **We're looking for someone who is**

* Trusted and credible — able to advise leaders and challenge them constructively
* Human-centric — genuinely good with people, and committed to change that people embrace
* Accountable and self-driven — you own the outcome, the big things and the small things
* A clear communicator and facilitator who moves groups from uncertainty to alignment
* Flexible and open to some travel in connection with client engagements
### **With us you get**

* A collaborative, flat organisation where support is a given.
* A clear career path and continuous learning through projects, mentorship and skills development.
* A vibrant company culture with strong team spirit, knowledge sharing and social activities that make work fun.
### **Selected benefits**

* Opportunity for part-ownership
* Competitive fixed salary
* 30 days holiday
* Company laptop, phone and subscription
  

Ready for the next step in your career? Send us your application.

*We make AI work in the real world — that's Sustainable Acceleration, delivered by people, not slides.*

title: Delivery Manager – Streaming & Integration (Confluent & Kafka)
description:
Nion is an IT consultancy and Tech Partner with offices in Stockholm, Malmö, Gothenburg, Oslo and London, plus nearshore delivery in North Macedonia and Bulgaria, where 220+ IT specialists work together to deliver tailored digital solutions. Together with Middlecon, now part of Nion, we help large and mid-market organisations across the Nordics turn data into real business value.


What we do spans Data, AI and Adoption. We bring open data and AI platforms such as the Nion AI Data Platform, deep IBM expertise through Middlecon in Db2, CDC and integration, a growing team of Kafka specialists, and AI-first Cloud Teams that run platforms for our clients. Real-time data is what ties it together — and that is exactly where this role sits.

**Why now**
===========


IBM completed its acquisition of Confluent in March 2026, and the partner landscape is being redrawn. Confluent is being integrated with watsonx.data, IBM MQ, webMethods and IBM Z, and sold through IBM's channels.


Nion has both sides: the IBM heritage through Middlecon and hands-on Kafka delivery, with streaming already in production for Nordic clients. We are a specialised Confluent partner in IBM Partner Plus, with license distribution through Arrow. Our ambition is to become the leading Nordic partner for IBM's open data stack — with Confluent at its centre.


We have the partnerships, the customers and a strong base of Kafka specialists. What we need now is the person who turns this into a practice: one clear offering, one team and one reputation for streaming and integration in the Nordics.

**What the role is**
--------------------


This is a business role for a technical expert: you own one competence area: data streaming and integration. That means the offering, the people, the delivery and the references, from first customer conversation to a platform running in production.


The role starts at 20–30% practice leadership; the rest of your time you work as a billable lead architect with our clients. You report to the CTO or head of delivery, and you work side by side with our alliance manager. The split is simple: the alliance manager owns the partners and the deal flow with IBM, Confluent and Arrow; you own the competence and the delivery.


We run two streaming tracks, and you lead both. The Confluent track serves large enterprises that run Confluent or need vendor support and SLAs — typically banks, telecom operators and public agencies with a large IBM MQ, Db2 or mainframe estate. The open track serves mid-market companies that want Apache Kafka without licences, built on the Nion AI Data Platform, on-prem or as a managed service. As an independent advisor, you help each client choose the right path — and we win the services work either way.

### **What you'll do**


You own the practice from offering to delivered result, working across five areas:


Offerings & reference architecture — owning the content, scope and pricing of our streaming offerings: fixed-price entry offerings such as ZooKeeper-to-KRaft migration and renewal reviews, implementation offerings such as Db2 and mainframe CDC into Confluent and MQ-to-Kafka bridges, and recurring services such as a Streaming Platform Team with SLA. You maintain the reference architecture we deliver against.


Competence & team — recruiting, certifying and developing the team, growing it substantially over the next three years. You build career paths, convert our best network consultants into employees, upskill Middlecon's Db2/CDC specialists and our Java developers in Confluent, and lead a team that spans Sweden and our nearshore centres.


Delivery quality & technical presales — being the technical authority in customer meetings and proposals, ensuring architecture reviews, escalation paths and consistent quality across every engagement, and turning delivered projects into referenceable cases.


Public face of the practice — speaking at our Open Data Forum, Kafka meetups and partner events, writing and being visible in the Kafka community, so that Nion becomes the name Nordic clients and candidates think of for streaming.


Practice performance — running the practice as a business together with the alliance manager: utilisation, pipeline of offerings, certifications and the economics of each engagement.


Throughout, you translate between architecture and business value — what moving from batch to real-time, or from MQ to Kafka, actually means for the client's operations, cost and compliance.


You are measured on utilisation, number of certified consultants, delivery quality and offerings sold.

### **Your profile**

* Minimum 10 years in integration or data architecture, with a strong track record in large organisations
* Minimum 5 years running Apache Kafka in production in enterprise environments — design, operation and troubleshooting at scale
* Confluent certification, or the ability to achieve it within three months of starting
* Experience leading consultants or technical teams — setting direction, developing people and owning quality
* Proven customer-facing presales: you can scope, price and win an engagement, and then stand behind it in delivery
* A clear understanding of event-driven architecture and how streaming fits alongside messaging, databases, lakehouses and AI
* Based in Sweden, fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken
### **What this role is not**


This is not a CTO role. Our CTO owns the company's overall technology strategy and platforms such as the Nion AI Data Platform, Software Factory and AI. You own one area as a business and you stay hands-on enough to be the strongest streaming architect in the room.


It is not a partner-management role either. Partner agreements, deal registration, co-marketing and the joint account plans with IBM and Confluent sit with our alliance manager; you make sure we can deliver what is sold, at the quality our clients expect.

#### **Technologies & areas you'll work with**


Streaming: Confluent Platform and Confluent Cloud, Apache Kafka, KRaft, Kafka Connect, Kafka Streams, Apache Flink, Schema Registry


IBM integration: IBM MQ, webMethods, Db2, IBM Z, change data capture (CDC), watsonx.data


Platforms & operations: Kubernetes and Confluent for Kubernetes (CFK), on-prem and air-gapped installations, managed services with SLA, security, disaster recovery and replication


Data & AI: Apache Iceberg and lakehouse architecture, the Nion AI Data Platform, real-time data for agentic AI


Compliance & resilience: DORA and NIS2 requirements, data sovereignty, exit strategies and logging

### **Meritorious**

* Experience with IBM MQ, CDC or Db2 — the bridge between the IBM estate and streaming
* Apache Flink, Kubernetes/CFK and hands-on ZooKeeper-to-KRaft migration
* A visible profile in the Kafka community: conference talks, meetups, blog posts or open-source contributions
* Experience from banking, telecom or other regulated environments
* Experience building up a practice, team or offering from an early stage
### **We're looking for someone who is**

* Technically credible — the architect other architects listen to, with clients and within the team
* Business-minded — you think in offerings, margins and references, not just in clusters and topics
* A builder of people — you enjoy recruiting, coaching and seeing others grow into experts
* Accountable and self-driven — you own the outcome, the big things and the small things
* A clear communicator — equally at ease on stage at a meetup, in a steering group and at the whiteboard
* Flexible and open to some travel to clients and our nearshore teams
### **With us you get**

* The chance to build and shape a practice from the start, at a moment when the Nordic Confluent market is being redrawn
* A specialised IBM and Confluent partnership behind you, and the whole stack in front of you: Kafka, Flink, CDC, lakehouse and AI
* Paid Confluent certification and continuous learning through projects, mentorship and skills development
* Nordic clients served by teams that combine Swedish leadership with nearshore capacity
* A stage at Open Data Forum and in the Kafka community
* A collaborative, flat organisation where support is a given, and a vibrant culture with strong team spirit
### **Selected benefits**

* Opportunity for part-ownership
* Competitive fixed salary
* 30 days holiday
* Company laptop, phone and subscription

Ready to build the Nordics' leading streaming practice? Send us your application.


We make AI work in the real world — that's Sustainable Acceleration, delivered by people, not slides.

title: Critical Environment Operations Manager
description:
**Overview**  

Microsoft’s Cloud Infrastructure and Operations (MCIO) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a **Critical Environment Operations Manager**, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive and the Microsoft Azure platform.


Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.


Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Empower a culture of safety, security, and compliance in all aspects of our Datacenter operations
* Lead a team of Mechanical, Electrical and Control System professionals supporting Microsoft's online services
* Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our Datacenters
* Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability to ensure optimal operational efficiency
* Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE) incidents year over year
* Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives
* Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring
* Establish and enhance strong working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and business partners
* Work with regional and global peers to share and build best practices across the entire datacenter portfolio

  

**Qualifications**  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Proven experience of mission-critical service management (e.g., providing IT services, manufacturing, warehouse, retail, military, or managing physical operations in an IT and/or critical environment infrastructure)
* Strong people management experience, including hiring, mentoring and team development
* You will be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid driver’s license will be required.
* + This role requires you to be on-site, and the location has limited public transport. Your own form of transport is advised
**Background Check Requirements:**


Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.


While not required, we also look for the following **Preferred Qualifications****:**

* Relevant experience in Critical Environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU) AND xperience working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) AND Experience managing budget $500k+
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field
* Experience in leading a diverse, technical team
* Bachelor’s Degree or Technical College certification in mechanical or electrical engineering and/or services
* Experience working on large scale CE projects
* Experience with the operation of IT infrastructure (Servers, SANs, Networking, etc.)

  

  

  

Data Center Operations Management M4 - The typical base pay range for this role across Sweden is kr 684,000.00 - kr 1,140,000.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.


Find additional benefits and pay information here:  

https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/sweden-corporate-pay.html

  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

  

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

title: Fintech Experience Architect - Presales
description:
**About the opportunity**
-------------------------



Ericsson Mobile Financial Services is looking for a Fintech Experience Architect to design and deliver compelling product demonstrations that bring our fintech solutions to life for customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.


In this customer-facing role, you will connect Ericsson’s technology capabilities with customer business objectives by creating clear storylines, tailored customer journeys, and live demonstrations that show the value of Ericsson MFS.


You will collaborate with Sales, Pre-Sales, Product Management, Marketing, Engineering, Architecture, and Customer Success teams to ensure demos are impactful, technically accurate, customer-ready, and aligned with market needs.

 **What you will do**


You will own the end-to-end demonstration experience for Ericsson MFS, from strategy and storytelling to technical readiness, delivery, enablement, and continuous improvement.

* Design, prepare, and deliver customer-focused demonstrations of Ericsson Mobile Financial Services solutions for customer meetings, workshops, executive briefings, industry events, and analyst engagements.
* Develop tailored demo scenarios, customer journeys, and business narratives aligned with customer priorities, market context, and buying objectives.
* Translate product capabilities and business storylines into technical demo solutions using Ericsson MFS capabilities.
* Own and maintain stable, secure, current, and customer-ready demo environments across the MFS portfolio, including readiness checks, dry-runs, issue resolution, and updates for new product features.
* Create and manage reusable demo assets such as scripts, storyboards, videos, product simulations, interactive showcases, sales enablement material, and industry use cases.
* Partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to support opportunity development, proposals, solution workshops, proof-of-concepts, and go-to-market initiatives.
* Train and enable customer-facing teams on demo content, storytelling, value articulation, and delivery techniques.
* Monitor market trends, competitor approaches, customer feedback, AI capabilities, and new visualization techniques to continuously improve demo effectiveness and business impact.
**What you bring**
------------------


*Business Competencies*

* Strong understanding of Mobile Financial Services, fintech ecosystems, digital payments, and customer engagement models.
* Ability to connect technical functionality to commercial value, business outcomes, and customer priorities.
* Customer-centric mindset with strong stakeholder management skills.

 *Technical Competencies*

* Knowledge of Ericsson Wallet Platform and associated MFS solutions.
* Understanding of APIs, integrations, cloud solutions, and digital platforms.
* Ability to configure, manage, and troubleshoot demo environments.

 *Professional Competencies*

* Excellent presentation, facilitation, communication, and storytelling skills.
* Ability to engage audiences ranging from technical experts to C-level executives.
* Creativity and innovation in shaping compelling customer experiences.

 *Preferred experience*

* Experience in technical pre-sales, solution consulting, solution architecture, product marketing, or customer-facing technology roles.
* Background in mobile money, digital payments, fintech, telecommunications, or digital financial services.
* Proven ability to deliver customer demonstrations, workshops, executive briefings, or similar customer-facing engagements in complex international environments.

  

Why join us?


Ericsson Mobile Financial Services enables digital financial inclusion and innovative fintech experiences worldwide. In this role, you will help customers experience our portfolio, understand our value, and see new possibilities for their business.


Ready to make an impact?


If you are motivated by customer engagement, fintech innovation, and bringing technology to life through meaningful demonstrations, we would like to hear from you.

 **Why join Ericsson?**At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.  

  

**What happens once you apply?**Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

 **Primary country and city:** Multi-Country

title: Information Management Architect
description:
**INFORMATION MANAGEMENT ARCHITECT**  

*with Purview*  

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**  

Full-time | Permanent | Sthlm/Gbg/Malmo

 **A B O U T X E N I T**  

Xenit is a growth company which specializes in Cloud and modern work. Our committed employees inspire, challenge and encourage each other, while providing extensive value for our customers.  

Xenit is **Microsoft's Partner of the Year, Sweden** for 2024, illustrating our commitment to technical development, being on the cutting edge of tech, and our close partnership with Microsoft.  

  

**W H A T W E N E E D**  

We are looking for a senior **IM Architect** to design & implement Information Management and Information Architecture strategies within Microsoft 365 and to act as a trusted advisor to our customers on Information Management, Compliance, Security, and Governance best practices.  

  

**Examples of potential tasks:**

* Lead customer workshops to establish governance, classification, retention and lifecycle management frameworks
* Define metadata strategies, taxonomies, content types and information structures
* Assess information landscapes and create roadmaps for governance, compliance and AI readiness
* Support customers in preparing their Microsoft 365 environment for Microsoft Copilot and AI adoption
* Design secure collaboration solutions in SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive and Exchange Online
* Implement and configure Microsoft Purview solutions for Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), eDiscovery and Records Management
* Establish policies, processes, and guidance supporting information governance and regulatory compliance
* Perform information risk assessments and provide recommendations for remediation and continuous improvement  

  

**C O U L D Y O U B E A M A T C H ?**  

**We believe our next IM Architect has:**
* 5+ years of experience working with **Information Management**, **Governance**, or **Information Security**
* Strong experience with **SharePoint Online** and **Microsoft 365** (inc. Teams, Exchange Online, and OneDrive)
* Strong experience working with **Microsoft Purview Compliance** and Information Protection solutions
* Deep understanding of **Information Architecture**: metadata, taxonomy, and content governance
* Experience designing **governance frameworks** and information lifecycle management processes
* Experience leading **workshops**, advisory engagements, and customer-facing projects
* Ability to translate business requirements into practical and **sustainable solutions**
* Interest in supporting businesses with digital tools, road-mapping, and advisory  

  

**It is a bonus if you have:**
* Experience supporting organizations in their **Copilot, AI, and Data Governance** journeys
* Knowledge of regulatory and compliance frameworks including **GDPR**, public sector regulations, and information management standards
* Relevant certifications such as: *SC-401, MS-102, SC-100, SC-200, SC-300*

 **We also believe that you are a person who:**  

* Acts on their own initiative, makes things happen and takes **responsibility** for their work
* Finds joy in learning about new technologies, and wants to keep up to date with trends in their field
* Has a methodical and structured way of working


- Understands complex issues and is able to solve them - making sensible and rational judgements.  

* Collaborates effectively with others and builds good relationships with both customers and colleagues
* Fluent in spoken and written Swedish and English
* Above all else, displays kindness and compassion in everything they do
  

**W H Y C H O O S E X E N I T ?**  

**Benefits**  

Xenit boasts a large benefits package, read full list here.  

  

**Super interesting colleagues**  

With us you will find spinning instructors, parkour practitioners, gamers, art historians, rugby players, puzzle maniacs, film geeks and much more.  

With us, you are free to be who you are. Our workforce is so diverse, that one of the only things each person has in common is an incredible drive and passion for what they do.  

  

**Activities**  

Each quarter, we host **Xenit Inspire** where employees are able to share specialist knowledge, information about cool projects, and take part in tasks centered around innovation - workshops and hackathons. We also offer annual conferences, team building, after works, and "Bring a Buddy" lunches at the office.  

  

Last year, Xenit was awarded **"Career Company of 2024"**. This prestigious recognition underscores our commitment to fostering a workplace culture that values inclusivity, well-being, and growth.  

*"Xenit is an outstanding employer where corporate culture and well-being are at the center. Here, the employees are part of a warm and inclusive community where their well-being and well-being are prioritized. By offering an environment where collaboration, creativity and innovation are encouraged, employees can thrive and develop while contributing to the company's success."*
